summary: RptMnuPlcSch_StudAssignSummary is a Web User Control in an ASP.NET application responsible for configuring, validating, and generating the Student Placement Schedule Summary report. It exposes interactive UI elements (checkboxes, dropdowns, radio buttons) that allow a user to select departments, programs, cohorts, campuses, report options, and advanced settings, then creates a print job via a backend method with these parameters.
purpose: To allow authorized users to generate a detailed student assignment summary report for placements and schedules, with options for customizing the output format and included information (e.g., contact info, comments, shift schedules).

workflows.name: Generate Student Assignment Summary Report
steps: User loads the report menu control.
Dropdowns for department, program, cohort, and campus are populated based on permissions and selections.
User selects students to include using UCchoosers.
User configures report options using checkboxes and radio buttons (e.g., include contact info, internal comments, PDF format).
Validation is performed to ensure selected options and limits (e.g., maximum included items).
PrintJobs.ReportStudentPlacementScheduleCreateJob is called with all selected parameters, generating the report.

workflows.name: Dropdown Dependency Updates
steps: Department selection triggers FillProgramDropdown and FillCohortDropdown.
Program selection triggers FillCohortDropdown and checkProgramPermission.

business_rules: Course Leader permission required to view internal comments (chkIncludeInternalComment.Enabled = selPrg.CLViewStudentInternalComment).
CustomValidator2 enforces maximum included items for report.
Only authorized programs and departments available based on UserSession.
Report can be generated as single or individual PDF files.
Page break option can be toggled for report output.
validations: ValidationSummary1 control for displaying validation messages.
CustomValidator1 and CustomValidator2 for custom error messages, maximum items, etc.
cmdRunReport does not run if critical parameters (e.g., UserSession) are missing.
calculations: MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS used to limit report generation.
Dropdown.CurrentID used to resolve selected IDs.
conditions: If UserSession.AllowAllPrograms, all programs are listed; else filtered.
If UserSession.Instructor and UserSession.CourseLeader, internal comment permission checked.
If UserSession is null, data source selection (dsCampus) is cancelled.
system_behavior: On page load, labels and validators are initialized with resource values.
Dropdowns dynamically populated based on session and selection.
Report generation logic calls backend PrintJobs methods with all parameters from UI.
JavaScript setup is performed for client-side UI variables.
exceptions: Critical parameters (UserSession, selected cohort/program/department) not set: report generation cancelled.
Exceeded maximum allowed items for report: CustomValidator2 error.
dsCampus datasource selection cancelled if UserSession is null.
